description: Count the ERROR-level alarms one cooling unit raised on a day when a sibling unit and WARN-level lines with the same code sit in the same journal. DISTILL-CANARY-b04c5e93

files.README.md:
# Kilmorie Colocation - CRAC alarms

Computer-room air conditioner units in the Kilmorie hall journal their state
every twenty minutes and raise alarms on top of the ordinary readings.
Levels are INFO, WARN and ERROR; each line names the unit that raised it.
